title: Skip Counting: The Fast Way to Count in Groups
description: A number-line visual for skip counting by 5s — a foundational skill before learning multiplication.
narration_lines: Skip counting is a fast way to count in groups.
Start at zero on the number line, marked every 5.
Six jumps of 5 gets you to 30, much faster than counting by ones.

params.footnote: faster than counting one by one
